overview_description.description: Taager is a social e-commerce platform enabling online merchants with end-to-end logistics. Taager is a social e-commerce platform that enables entrepreneurs to start online businesses without inventory, capital, or logistics hassle. It provides products, warehousing, shipping, and cash collection services, allowing sellers to focus on marketing and sales. Operating mainly in MENA regions like Egypt, UAE, and Saudi Arabia, Taager supports thousands of online merchants with a marketplace, analytics tools, and end-to-end fulfillment infrastructure.
